name: robinhood
notes: Robinhood Chain mainnet (Arbitrum Orbit, gas in ETH). The public RPC is rate-limited; point ROBINHOOD_RPC at a QuickNode/Dwellir/ArrowRPC endpoint for the keeper and watcher. $VRAM is a Pons launch; the round mine is deployed with --prelaunch and receives the token through launch(), so rig stays zero here. Pons pools have no fungible LP token, so LP staking is off (lpToken zero). Deploy OpenEligibility and ChainlinkOracle (feeds below) with deploy-adapters and pass their addresses to the deploy. Testnet: chain id 46630 at https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com.
externalNote: Pons V2 (verified on chain 2026-09-10): launch factory, the fee escrow the creator fee recipient claims ETH from, the Uniswap v4 meme hook of graduated pools. Pons V1 (factory 0xA5aA…1feB, locker 0x736D…7F35) is not used.
feedsNote: Chainlink proxies on chain 4663 (reference-data-directory feeds-robinhood-mainnet.json, 2026-09-04): 8 decimals, 24 h heartbeat, 0.5% deviation. NVDA verified live at $230.24. Also available: SPY 0x319724394D3A0e3669269846abE664Cd621f9f6A, ETH/USD 0x78F3556b67E17Df817D51Ef5a990cDaF09E8d3A9, USDG/USD 0x61B7e5650328764B076A108EFF5fa7282a1B9aD2. Deploy ChainlinkOracle(stocks, feeds) and put its address in `oracle`; deploy OpenEligibility for `eligibility`.
feeWalletNote: Client wallet (2026-09-08), optional manual funder (fund-rounds). Not the fee recipient: the FeeFunder contract is entered as the creator fee recipient at the Pons V2 launch and wired with rounds-admin set-source (docs/RUNBOOK-ROUNDS §2b).
poolsNote: Uniswap v3 pools of each Stock Token against WETH on chain 4663, discovered 2026-09-08 via factory.getPool: the deepest WETH pool per stock (NVDA 0.05%: 1.7e22 liquidity; MU 0.3%: 5.2e20; SNDK 0.3%: 3.0e20; QQQ 0.3%: 2.8e21). FeeFunder swaps against these; the owner can re-point with setLegs.
